name: Ninigi
source: Ninigi is the son of Touma Takeru and Tsukuyomi, the older sister of Amaterasu, from Izumo and, for this reason, is the stepbrother of Sakuya.
translation: Ninigi is the son of Touma Takeru and Tsukuyomi, the older sister of Amaterasu, from Izumo and, for this reason, is the stepbrother of Sakuya.
